dashboard.title: Human Resources Dashboard
dashboard.hubDescription: Manage staff records, payroll, salary settings, and other HR-related tasks.
dashboard.enhancementNote: Dashboard enhanced with quick links and employment type chart.

payrollPeriods.title: Payroll Periods Management
payrollPeriods.description: Define payroll periods for processing staff salaries. Link them to financial years and optionally to school periods.
payrollPeriods.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this payroll period? This might affect existing payslips.

payrollItemTypes.title: Payroll Item Types Management
payrollItemTypes.description: Define various types of payroll items such as earnings, deductions, and contributions.
payrollItemTypes.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this payroll item type? This might affect staff salary settings and payslips.

staffSalarySettings.title: Staff Salary Settings
staffSalarySettings.description: Manage salary configurations for each staff member, including basic pay and recurring allowances or deductions.
staffSalarySettings.noRecurringItems: No recurring items added for this staff member yet.
staffSalarySettings.deleteRecurringItemConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this recurring item?

payslips.title: Payslips Management
payslips.noPayslipsMessage: No payslips generated for the selected period yet, or no staff salary settings found for active staff.
payslips.selectPeriodMessage: Please select a payroll period to view or generate payslips.
payslips.alertSelectPeriod: Please select a payroll period to generate payslips.
